bio.text: Mike Veile represents Idaho House District 35, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Soda Springs as the legislator's city.
The directory biography says Veile grew up in Rexburg and holds bachelor's and master's degrees in mechanical engineering from Utah State University.
It says Veile spent over 30 years in heavy industry, mostly in Soda Springs producing elemental phosphorus, and now provides engineering solutions as an individual business.
